fields.label: coefficient
fields.guidance: Return 235 only when the 235 checkbox is visibly ticked; the 234.5 box is printed but unticked in the supplied example.

instructions: Series number and sample code are different header cells. Copy each from its own printed label; do not swap them or infer from another form.
On page 2 thermal coefficient is selected by a tick box. Return the ticked option (235 or 234.5), not the nearest printed number.
For time-series rows 14 and 15 (keys time_series.13 and .14), align each handwritten entry to its printed column; a diagonal stroke or merged mark is not a value. Mark uncertain cells illegible.
If a whole line is crossed out, mark its affected cells struck_out and preserve any legible struck text for review.
